This is the deadline sum: 'we will reply within five working days' from a ticket's date, a payment due date, a notice period. description: Look up UK bank holidays from a workflow, straight from GOV.UK. List the bank holidays for a year or between two dates, get the next one coming up, check whether a date, or today, is a bank holiday, find when a named one falls, count the working days between two dates with weekends and bank holidays taken out, and work out a deadline a number of working days away. England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland keep three different calendars and this handles all three, including comparing a date across them in one step, so a business with an office in Edinburgh and one in London gets the right answer for each. Substitute days are flagged rather than left in a note. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
